decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>The window in the flank elevation of the proposed development shall:
</p><p>(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
</p><p>(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows / doors, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p>BHA/0604 Sheet 01 – loft conversion, BHA/0604 Sheet 01 – single storey rear extension, BHA/0604 Sheet 02 – loft conversion, BHA/0604 Sheet 02 – single storey rear extension, BHA/0604 Sheet 03, BHA/0604 Sheet 04, BHA/0604 Sheet 05 – Site Location Plan, BHA/0604 Sheet 06, Form 4 – Reasonable Exception Statement.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
description: Single storey rear extension, Alterations and extension to roof to form rear dormer, Roof lights in front roof slope
